note: Japanese prefectures (3府43県 + 北海道庁) from 1891-01-01 — the day after the Meiji reconstruction (meiji-prefectures.json) ends — to 1943-06-30, the last day of 東京府. Drawn by scripts/histrecon/assembled/fuken-1891.mjs as unions of the 1920 町村 of 国土数値情報 N03-1920 (munis-n03-1920.mjs). The 1920 prefecture of a 町村 is its prefecture on every day of the scope EXCEPT where a fact below says otherwise: `moves` (a whole 1920 町村 on the other side before/after a dated change), `mixed` (a 1920 町村 holding land of two prefectures in a window — withheld from both in that window, because no part finer than the 町村 is used here), `islands` (a polygon of a 1920 町村 that was not Japanese territory, or whose incorporation date is not settled, before a date). Prefecture identity (id, names, wikidata) is read from meiji-prefectures.json: the unit with no end whose names.ja is the 1920 prefecture name (alias below). Sources are Japanese Wikipedia revisions (oldid) summarised in `says`.

scope.toNote: 1943-07-01 東京府 became 東京都 (東京都制, 昭和18年法律第89号); the record stops for every unit on the same day so that one assembler states one era. 樺太庁 (内地 from 1943-04-01) is drawn by data/hist-admin1.js and is not part of this record.

aliases.why: N03-1920 writes the prefecture name 北海道; the first-level unit of 1886-01-26 to 1947 is 北海道庁 (meiji-prefectures.json id 北海道庁).

completeness.method: Prefectural boundary changes 1891–1943 were collected from (1) 越境合併 §戦前の境界変更 (oldid 110558853), (2) every 府県境界変更 law in 日本の廃止された法律 (oldid 110445708: 明治26年法律第12号, 明治28年法律第24号, 明治29年法律第56号, 明治32年法律第4号, 明治40年法律第8号, 明治45年法律第5号 — no other title of the form 〜府〜県境界変更 1890–1945), (3) the 沿革 sections of the 郡 on each side (北多摩郡, 荏原郡, 橘樹郡, 東葛飾郡, 猿島郡, 稲敷郡, 香取郡) and of the municipalities named. Island incorporations were read island by island for every polygon of N03-1920 that lies outside the four main islands' coastal waters and is named in an incorporation after 1891.
completeness.limits: From 1899 (府県制 改正) a municipal boundary change that crossed a prefectural line could move the prefectural line without a law of its own (the 1926 浮間 case has no law in the list). Such changes were looked for only through 越境合併 and the 郡 articles above; a cross-border 大字 move recorded nowhere in those would be missing.

unresolved.what: 千島 north of 択捉 (得撫郡・新知郡・占守郡) — not drawn
unresolved.why: N03-1920 was compiled on the 1950 municipalities and carries no polygon for the central and northern Kuril Islands (MEASURED 2026-10-06: the only 北海道 parts east of 145.5°E are 歯舞・色丹・国後・択捉・紗那・蘂取), so 北海道庁 is drawn without them although they were Japanese and under 根室支庁 from the 1875 樺太・千島交換条約 to 1945. This is an omission, not a claim: the record says nothing about that ground.
